audience: Codex app users and Decodex operators
text:
Codex app 26.602 is out.

What changed:
- Profile activity insights and share cards
- Better Computer Use startup and appshot errors
- Browser/review UI fixes plus expanded onboarding

Changelog: https://developers.openai.com/codex/changelog
evidence_notes: The official Codex changelog lists Codex app updates 26.602 on 2026-06-04 with profile activity insights, share cards, Computer Use/appshot reliability, browser/review UI fixes, and onboarding role choices.

The social_candidate/v1 artifact at artifacts/github/social-candidates/openai-codex-app-26-602.json has decision.worthiness = publish, mode = release_pulse, and idempotency key x:decodexspace:codex-app-26-602:release_pulse.
Asia/Shanghai cap accounting found zero checked-in @decodexspace published records for 2026-06-06 before posting.
Repository idempotency scan found no existing social_post/v1 record with x:decodexspace:codex-app-26-602:release_pulse before posting.
X duplicate detection for from:decodexspace with the exact phrase Codex app 26.602 returned no results before composing.
Chrome account readback initially showed the hackink controller account, then the X account switcher selected Decodex @decodexspace and visible page readback confirmed @decodexspace before composing.

A fresh candidate-specific decodex_signal_card image was generated locally at /Users/x/.codex/decodex/social-media/x/2026-06-06/openai-codex-app-26-602/image.png with sha256 598f61806c1ccc0a43efb678cfb5f05f3cc150fd7d2808645459852d66dbe31b.
The X file chooser upload path succeeded once; composer readback showed Edit media and Remove media controls before submit.
Timeline readback showed the newly published @decodexspace post with status 2063109099135574379 and a /photo/1 media link.
Independent permalink readback confirmed @decodexspace, Automated by @hackink, the expected post text, the OpenAI changelog link, and the attached image media URL.

claims.text: Codex app 26.602 includes Profile activity insights and share cards.
Codex app 26.602 improves Computer Use startup readiness and appshot error reporting.
Codex app 26.602 includes browser and review UI fixes plus expanded onboarding role choices.
The published X post includes generated media and a readable /photo/1 media URL.

decision.reason: The official changelog has concrete user-visible app changes and enough reader value for a source-led release pulse.

caveats: Sharing for profile cards is described by the official changelog as available on consumer ChatGPT plans.
The local media file is outside Git by default; this record keeps the final X status, /photo/1 URL, and media readback URL instead of committing the generated binary.
The media card was generated by deterministic SVG overlay and local PNG rendering; final X readback confirmed the image attachment, but no Made with AI label was observed in the permalink text.
